subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What canonical user-facing label should OpenClaw use for the stable `google-vertex` provider now that Google branding is changing?
rationale: The code fix is small, but the issue discussion already shows plausible alternatives and repository policy treats provider routing and user-facing copy as product-sensitive.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Updates UI/docs copy to the current Google-branded name while retaining the familiar Vertex AI qualifier and the stable `google-vertex` id.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI
options.body: Matches the reporter's original wording but may drift from the current Google docs terminology noted in the issue discussion.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI
options.body: Avoids copy churn until Google naming stabilizes, but leaves the reported confusion in current UI and docs.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Updates UI/docs copy to the current Google-branded name while retaining the familiar Vertex AI qualifier and the stable `google-vertex` id.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest issue discussion specifically routed the label choice to @BunsDev for UI/UX and docs naming judgment.
